settings.title: Dada Todo List Settings
settings.openLocationDesc: Where the panel opens. Changes apply immediately.
settings.menuViewsDesc: Check to show or hide a view in the menu; drag to reorder.
settings.menuStyleDesc: View-switching menu style: bottom horizontal pill, or left vertical rail.
settings.showLunarDesc: Show lunar dates, solar terms, festivals and work/rest holiday badges in day, week and month views. Turn off for Gregorian dates only.
settings.addDoneDateMarker: Add completion date marker when completing a task
settings.addDoneDateMarkerDesc: Append the completion date to the end of the task line, for example ✅ 2026-10-06.
settings.weekStartDesc: First column of the week view and month calendar. Choose Sunday through Saturday; default Monday.
settings.colorSchemeDesc: Color scheme for task blocks in the day, week and month views.
settings.timelineRangeDesc: Day and week views show only this span on the timeline, in whole hours from 0 to 24, with end later than start. Default 00:00 to 24:00. Timed tasks outside the span are hidden from the timeline.
settings.timeStepDesc: When editing task time, dropdown options are generated at this minute step, from 5 to 60. Default 5.
settings.snapMinutesDesc: Dragging or resizing timeline blocks snaps to this minute interval. Options: 5 / 10 / 15 / 30, default 30.
settings.showScheduledDesc: When enabled, a scheduled date (⏳) can be set in the task editor and a scheduled-date badge is shown on task blocks across views.
settings.tagColorsDesc: Click a dot to set a color for an existing tag.
settings.inboxFileDesc: File that stores tasks without a date, as a path relative to the vault root. Created automatically on startup if missing. ⚠️ Do not add the checklist file marker to the inbox file.
settings.journalFolderDesc: Folder holding your journals, where dated tasks live. The plugin scans this folder and its subfolders for notes whose filename contains a date. Default / means the vault root. Point it at a journals-only folder to avoid false matches.
settings.journalLooseMatchDesc: On by default. When on, a date is extracted from anywhere in the filename, tolerating names like 2026-10-03-Sat, 10-03-2026, or any weekday and prefix/suffix. When off, only names starting with a date or weekday plus date count as journals, so ordinary notes that merely contain a date are not misread.
settings.inboxMoveAsk: The old inbox still has {{n}} task(s). Move them to the new file?
settings.inboxMoved: Moved {{n}} task(s) to the new inbox
settings.dailyWindowDesc: Load only daily notes within N days before and after today; tasks outside that range won't appear in the panel. Lower it on large vaults for faster loading, or choose All for full history. Default: All.
settings.checklistFolderDesc: Folder where newly created checklist files are stored (relative to the vault root). Defaults to "清单"; use / for the vault root. Only affects new files — existing checklists are still detected by their frontmatter tag anywhere in the vault.
settings.checklistTagDesc: Add one or more tags. Notes whose frontmatter tags include any of them, or a sub-tag such as todoList/work, are treated as checklists.
settings.tagPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter, for example todoList
settings.remindEnabledDesc: Remind you with a notification and a short sound when a task is due; every unfinished task due today is included. ⚠️ Desktop only: there is no background push, so nothing fires while Obsidian is closed or in the background.
settings.remindChannelDesc: System notifications are OS popups, desktop only, and need permission. In-app shows a notice in Obsidian's top-right corner, which is also the fallback when permission is missing.
settings.remindAllDayDesc: All-day tasks have no time of day, so they fire at the time below. Turn off to remind only tasks with a set time.
settings.remindAllDayTimeDesc: Every all-day task of the day is reminded at this time, for example 10:00.
settings.remindTestDesc: Send a test reminder with sound to check notifications. Asks for system permission if not granted yet.
settings.author: Author
settings.feedbackDesc: If you run into issues, {issue} or message the author on Xiaohongshu.
settings.rebuildIndexDesc: Rescan daily notes, inbox and checklist files to rebuild the task index. The time it takes depends on the number of task files — please wait patiently. Use this when view data no longer matches file contents.
settings.projectsRootDesc: Folder that acts as the project database (relative to the vault root), defaults to "任务". Each subfolder is a project; its project file task-<name>.md holds unarchived tasks.
settings.projectCwdDesc: Working directory used when a sub-project has no cwd of its own, and the default location for T3 Code delegations. A project file's cwd frontmatter overrides it.
settings.t3BinaryDesc: Command or full path used to launch T3 Code. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH first, then /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and similar).
settings.reverseSyncDesc: Periodically read T3 Code sessions created outside this plugin, match them to a project by working directory (or today's journal), and append them as a task plus one delegation line.
settings.syncIntervalDesc: How often session state is refreshed (running / needs you / done). Default 60, range 15–600.
settings.syncMinAgeDesc: Only sync sessions that started at least this many minutes ago, so a just-sent request isn't registered twice. Default 3; 0 disables the limit.
settings.manualSyncDesc: Read all T3 sessions grouped by working directory with ownership status: unowned ones can get a project (auto-importing all history and moving journal blocks back), go to the journal, or be ignored; owned ones can import their unbound sessions; ignored / journal-only ones can be reset to unowned.
settings.unmatchedPromptDesc: When a session's working directory has no matching project, ask once: create a project (optionally importing history), keep it in today's journal, or ignore the workspace. Closing the prompt keeps the journal. Re-adjust ownership via manual sync.
settings.summaryMaxCharsDesc: Maximum characters of the session summary shown on a delegation line. Default 200, range 40–1000.
settings.t3ProviderDesc: Provider id passed to T3 Code when delegating. Leave empty to use the project default; required for projects without a default model.
settings.t3ModelDesc: Model id used when delegating. Leave empty to use the project default; required for projects without a default model.

modals.linkTextPlaceholder: Link text (leave blank to use URL)

summaryLlmBaseUrlDesc: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1). If any of URL/model/key is empty, LLM summarization is disabled and the delegation falls back to truncated text.
summaryLlmModelDesc: Model name used for summarization (e.g. deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini).
summaryLlmApiKeyDesc: API key for the summary LLM, stored in this vault's config only.
summarySilentMinutesDesc: When a session has been silent for this many minutes AND its user-prompt count increased, re-summarize and overwrite the previous title and points. Default 30.
